title: Harvesting OP50 for C. elegans Liquid Culture
author: Vidur Sabharwal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xcmfiu6

steps.title: Inoculate LB flasks and incubate
steps.instruction: After an 8‑hour starter incubation, add 2 mL of E. coli OP50 LB culture to each of three 250 mL LB flasks, then place the flasks in a shaking incubator set to 180 rpm, 37 °C, overnight (≈17 h).

steps.title: Weigh empty centrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Weigh three 50 mL centrifuge tubes and record the empty‑tube weight on each tube.

steps.title: Aliquot culture and centrifuge
steps.instruction: On Day 2, use a serological pipette to transfer 40 mL of the overnight OP50 culture into each pre‑weighed tube, then centrifuge in a swing‑bucket rotor at 3,220 × g, 10 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and repeat centrifugation
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant, then repeat the centrifugation (step 3) until all culture has been processed. After the final spin, keep each tube inverted with the lid on, let stand for several minutes, pipette out any residual liquid from the lid, weigh the tube, and calculate the pellet weight.

substeps.instruction: Invert tube and stand several minutes
Remove residual liquid from lid with pipette
Weigh tube and compute pellet weight

steps.title: Calculate suspension volume and store
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume of S complete medium required to obtain a bacterial suspension of 30 g L⁻¹, mark this volume on the tube, date and label the tube, then store at –20 °C for 1–3 months or at –80 °C for longer storage.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet and pool
steps.instruction: Allow the frozen pellet to thaw, add the calculated volume of S complete medium to each tube, vortex gently to resuspend, and pool the contents of all tubes to obtain the final volume needed for nematode culture, maintaining sterile conditions throughout.
